title: FDA Issues Warning About Certain Supplements Substituted with Toxic Yellow Oleander | FDA

Based on the FDA’s sampling and testing results thus far, the FDA is also concerned that other products marketed as tejocote root (including with other names such as *Crataegus mexicana*, Raiz de Tejocote, and Mexican Hawthorn) may contain yellow oleander. The FDA has added two additional products containing toxic yellow oleander to this Safety Alert. The FDA has added three additional products containing toxic yellow oleander to this Safety Alert. While a few have initiated voluntary recalls (please see the updates made to the table above), the FDA is concerned that products containing toxic yellow oleander remain on the marketplace.
